name: Indiana University Bloomington
tuition_note: In-state (Indiana resident) undergraduate tuition & mandatory fees 2026-27 = $12,142 from studentcentral.indiana.edu/cost-of-iu. Housing is room only (excludes meal plan, billed separately); $8,275 is a representative Standard room rate (e.g. Teter/Forest/Read/McNutt Standard) from rps.indiana.edu/living-on-campus/rates-billing/2026-27-rates.html. Room rates range roughly $6,312-$15,773 by neighborhood/building/category.
